get.summary: Query programme entries for map display, filterable by taxonomy, education level, inclusion, location, agreement, keyword, organisation, and scale
get.description: Returns entries matching the given filters. Taxonomy (category/sub-category/item), education level, and inclusion group/type filters match entries with at least one qualifying activity. Location filters match via programme_locations. Agreement filters match via government_agreements. Keyword and organisation name filters use case-insensitive partial matching. Scale filters bucket by budget band, or by numeric staff/beneficiary ranges. All filters combine with AND. Respects BE-010/BE-025 visibility rules: nep_admin and nep_coordinator see all entries, member_org sees only their own organisation's entries.

parameters.description: Filter by education level ID (via programme_activity_levels)

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against entry keywords

parameters.name: organisation_name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against organisation name

parameters.name: province_id
parameters.description: Filter by province ID (matches entries with locations in this province or its districts)

parameters.name: agreement_counterpart_type
parameters.description: Filter by government agreement counterpart agency type

get.summary: Export filtered programme entries as CSV
get.description: Returns a CSV file containing all key fields for entries matching the given filters. Uses the same filters and permissions as the query endpoint. CSV includes entry details, organisation info, budget, staff, beneficiaries, locations, activities, keywords, and government agreements.

get.description: Returns a PDF file containing a readable summary report of entries matching the given filters. Uses the same filters and permissions as the query endpoint. PDF includes formatted sections for entry details, organisation info, budget, staff, beneficiaries, locations, activities, keywords, and government agreements. Large result sets are processed in chunks to prevent timeouts.

post.summary: Save Section 2 activity selections for a programme entry
post.description: Accepts one or more activity selections, each with a taxonomy item, inclusion flag/group/type, multiple education levels, and a primary/secondary flag. Inclusion is recorded once per activity item, not per education level. Rejects inactive or deprecated taxonomy items. When a selected item is flagged "Other", the accompanying free-text value is required (SRS 5.5) and is captured in the taxonomy other-queue for later admin review.

other_text.description: Required when the selected activity_item_id is flagged as "Other" (SRS 5.5)
